summary: 22 errors, 31 minor. Main themes: glossary violations (rakṣas=demon in 22-26, arāti in 26, ājya in 35, vāja in 37), additions in English (brackets and 'power' in 27, [serving] in 14), Hindi vipra mistranslation (14) and preṣe (7). Draft notes agree: j for anusvara (7, 10, 12) flagged correctly; sanatāptam in 33 flagged correctly (the Devanagari also lacks the virama); low-confidence 9, 17, 32, 34 are fair; 24 should be medium. No regrouping suggested (unit 9 line c holds two formulas plus the closing phrase, but keep the edition's grouping).
